capabilities: delay loading of non-essential plugins until after startup
search plugins by name in the settings page
group plugins into load-at-startup, load-later, and disabled states
enable or disable plugins without leaving the page
record measured startup load times per plugin
extras: Documentation is in Chinese. Requires Obsidian 1.11.0 or higher. It only manages community plugins' load timing and enable state, not core plugins or workspace layout. Installable via the community plugin directory, BRAT, or manual download; no account or external service needed.
intentEvidence: 和 Lazy Loader 的区别
problem: Obsidian loads every enabled plugin at startup, which makes opening the app slow when many plugins are installed, especially on mobile.

relations.evidence: 和 Lazy Loader 的区别

summary: Startup-speed plugin that defers loading non-essential community plugins until after Obsidian opens, managed from a searchable settings page.
